newsitem.title: UK: Siebe says Stephens to retire as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Siebe says Stephens to retire as chairman.

text.p: British engineering group Siebe Plc said on Thursday chairman E.B. Stephens was to retire from the board in May 1998 and would be succeeded by Colin Marshall, the current chairman of British Airways Plc.
Marshall joins the board on January 1, 1998 as a non-executive director and deputy chairman.
Siebe's managing director Allen Yurko told shareholders its market conditions in its main geographic regions were strong, with North America showing strong growth.
He described the group's UK business as buoyant and said its European operations were showing improved signs of business activity.
"We therefore remain confident and poised to deliver a very successful 1997/98," Yurko said.
